# EthosScales

> A free political values test. People answer up to 130 statements and are placed on 13 axes, then matched to the closest of 242 ideologies and 268 parties. Every ideology is defined from its own founding text. No account is needed.

## Key facts

- Address: https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/
- Cost: free, with no sign up
- Lengths: Quick (26 statements), Full (65), Deep (130)
- The 13 axes: Economy (Market to Planned); Ownership (Private to Collective); Rights (Liberty to Security); Government (Democracy to Autocracy); Structure (Decentralised to Centralised); Nation (Internationalist to Nationalist); Immigration (Multiculturalist to Assimilationist); Values (Progressive to Traditional); Technology (Accelerationist to Precautionary); Environment (Industrialist to Environmentalist); Religion (Secular to Religious); Military (Pacifist to Militarist); Trade (Free Trade to Protectionist)
- Results show the closest ideology, a classic four quadrant compass, a twelve faced 3D map called the dodecahedron, the closest parties, and reading suggestions
- People can compare results with a friend or dare a friend to answer as another ideology
- Answers are scored in the browser. Nothing is saved unless the person chooses to share it
- Positions of ideologies and parties are editorial estimates, and corrections are welcome
- Code licence: MIT

## Pages

- [Take the test](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/)
- [All ideologies](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideologies.html): 229 pages, one per ideology, each with a definition, founder, founding text and 13 scores
- [All parties](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/parties.html): 268 parties by country with the document each is placed from
- [Terms, privacy and cookies](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/legal.html)

- [Hamiltonianism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/hamiltonianism.html): A strong national government that builds national industry.

- [Hegelian Constitutional Monarchism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/hegelian-constitutional-monarchism.html): Freedom made actual in the family, civil society and the state.
- [Carlism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/carlism.html): God, Fatherland, Fueros, King.
- [Prussian Socialism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/prussian-socialism.html): Socialism as duty and service to the state, not as class struggle.
- [Conservative Revolution](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/conservative-revolution.html): Against liberalism and party rule, a new Reich above the parties.
- [Nouvelle Droite (European New Right)](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/nouvelle-droite.html): The right to difference, against a single world culture.
- [Perennialist Traditionalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/perennialist-traditionalism.html): Spiritual authority above temporal power.
- [Divine Right Absolutism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/divine-right-absolutism.html): Kings rule as fathers, by the authority God gave Adam.
- [Aristocratic Radicalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/aristocratic-radicalism.html): Rank and the higher human being, against the morality of the herd.
- [Carlylean Hero Worship](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/carlylean-hero-worship.html): History is the biography of great men, and the ablest should rule.
- [Catholic Integralism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/catholic-integralism.html): The state owes public recognition to the Catholic faith.
- [Civic Nationalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/civic-nationalism.html): A nation is a daily plebiscite.
- [Romantic Nationalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/romantic-nationalism.html): A people is made by its language, and remade by its schools.
- [Mazzinian Republicanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/mazzinianism.html): God and the people.
- [Pan Slavism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/pan-slavism.html): The Slavs are a civilisation of their own, not a part of Europe.
- [Garveyism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/garveyism.html): Africa for the Africans, at home and abroad.
- [Three Principles of the People](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/three-principles-of-the-people.html): Nationalism, democracy, the people's livelihood.
- [Revisionist Zionism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/revisionist-zionism.html): Settlement behind an iron wall of force.
- [Irish Republicanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/irish-republicanism.html): A sovereign republic, won in arms, for all the people of Ireland.
- [Nehruvian Secular Nationalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/nehruvian-nationalism.html): One nation out of many faiths and languages.
- [Pancasila](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/pancasila.html): Five principles for one nation of many islands and faiths.
- [Bolivarianism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/bolivarianism.html): Independence, union and a strong republic for Spanish America.
- [Pan Turkism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/pan-turkism.html): A political union of all the Turks.
- [Kokutai Thought](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/kokutai.html): One nation as one family under a divine and unbroken imperial line.
- [Economic Nationalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/economic-nationalism.html): The power to produce wealth matters more than wealth itself.
- [British Fascism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/british-fascism.html): A corporate state and a closed imperial economy.
- [Rexism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/rexism.html): A Catholic and corporatist revolt against the Belgian party system.
- [Estado Novo Corporatism (Salazarism)](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/salazarism.html): A strong state without parties, bounded by Catholic morals.
- [Shōwa Statism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/showa-statism.html): A coup in the emperor's name, state control of big capital, empire abroad.
- [Liberation Theology](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/liberation-theology.html): Theology done from the side of the poor.
- [Christian Reconstructionism (Theonomy)](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/christian-reconstructionism.html): The law of Moses as the standard for every society.
- [Neo Calvinism (Sphere Sovereignty)](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/neo-calvinism.html): Each sphere of life answers to God, not to the state.
- [Political Augustinianism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/political-augustinianism.html): Two cities, formed by two loves.
- [Thomism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/thomism.html): Government exists for the common good.
- [Islamic Modernism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/islamic-modernism.html): Reopen the gates of independent reasoning.
- [Islamic Democracy](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/islamic-democracy.html): Elections, pluralism and rights grounded in Islamic sources.
- [Religious Zionism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/religious-zionism.html): The return to the Land as the beginning of redemption.
- [Engaged Buddhism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/engaged-buddhism.html): Practice that goes out to meet suffering in society.
- [Dhammic Socialism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/dhammic-socialism.html): Take only what you need; the rest belongs to all.
- [Integral Humanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/integral-humanism.html): Body, mind, intellect and soul, for the person and the nation alike.
- [Anabaptist Pacifism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/anabaptist-pacifism.html): A church apart, without sword or oath.
- [Social Gospel](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/social-gospel.html): The Kingdom of God as a just social order on earth.
- [Christian Realism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/christian-realism.html): Individuals can be unselfish; groups rarely are.
- [Aristotelian Polity](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/aristotelian-polity.html): A mixed constitution resting on a strong middle class.
- [Stoic Cosmopolitanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/stoic-cosmopolitanism.html): All rational beings are citizens of one city.
- [Machiavellian Republicanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/machiavellian-republicanism.html): A free republic kept alive by conflict, law and its own arms.
- [Legalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/legalism.html): Rule by law, reward and punishment, not by virtue.
- [Mohism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/mohism.html): Impartial care for all, and an end to wars of aggression.
- [Daoism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/daoism.html): Govern by not interfering.
- [Kautilyan Statecraft](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/kautilyan-statecraft.html): The science of acquiring and keeping the earth.
- [Hobbesian Absolutism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/hobbesian-absolutism.html): Without a common power, a war of all against all.
- [Rousseauian Republicanism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/rousseauian-republicanism.html): Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.
- [Montesquieuan Constitutionalism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/montesquieuan-constitutionalism.html): Power must be arranged so that power checks power.
- [Morean Utopianism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/morean-utopianism.html): An island with no money and no private property.
- [Digger Communism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/digger-communism.html): The earth held in common, with no buying and selling.
- [Neo Libertarian Falangism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/neo-libertarian-falangism.html): Deregulate everything, for the unity of destiny.
- [Monarcho Brezhnevism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/monarcho-brezhnevism.html): A hereditary throne atop a five year plan.
- [Anarcho Monarchism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/anarcho-monarchism.html): A king who leaves everyone alone.
- [Posadism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/posadism.html): Nuclear war, then socialism, then the aliens.
- [Fully Automated Luxury Communism](https://ethoscales.github.io/ethoscales/ideology/luxury-space-communism.html): Robots do the work. Everyone gets the good life.
